messages.author: 6fbf4419e048b767
messages.subject: Rstan - Parallel Computing
parts:
Hello, 
I saw this post: http://andrewgelman.com/2015/03/03/one-simple-trick-to-make-stan-automatically-runs-in-parallel-from-r/
and am wondering if the parallel computing is actually implemented in the current Rstan 2.9.0 verson.
Thanks!

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Rstan - Parallel Computing
parts:
On Tuesday, January 12, 2016 at 3:25:29 PM UTC-5, Yao Xiong wrote:
I saw this post: http://andrewgelman.com/2015/03/03/one-simple-trick-to-make-stan-automatically-runs-in-parallel-from-r/
and am wondering if the parallel computing is actually implemented in the current Rstan 2.9.0 verson.

It was implemented months ago; don't worry about that link. Call

options(mc.cores = 4)

or something before calling stan() or sampling(). Alternatively, stan() and sampling() have a cores argument.

Ben
